Add a screen to get started
Your files stay in your browser · v 1.0Saved automatically on this deviceCreated by: Johnpaul (@Ayo_Design)

Screens to showreel.

  1. Add up to 12 images. Your original dimensions and transparent pixels are kept. Choose a source as the canvas size reference or enter a custom width and height. Screens fit without cropping or stretching. Uploads sort naturally by filename, so Screen 2 comes before Screen 10. Drag the screens to change the order, or use Sort by name to restore filename order.
  2. Set your pace. Change time per screen or total duration. Choose Soft or Stiff. Click the transition description to adjust its length.
  3. Choose a background. Use #fefefe, #0e0e0e, a custom color, a gradient, or an uploaded image. Select None for transparent GIF or PNG export. Adjust padding and border radius to frame your work. Video requires a solid, gradient, or image background.
  4. Choose your format. Export the current preview frame as PNG, a 30 fps video, or a looping, full-resolution GIF with transitions sampled at 20 fps. GIF uses up to 256 colors per frame.

Video renders in real time; keep this tab visible. GIF renders frame by frame and may take longer. Your uploads, settings, and output stay in your browser.
